item_arguments.argument: Construct the product conditional kernel using iterated section integration and kernel measurability. Verify its RCD identities on rectangles by the supplied conditional-law identity and independence, extend by pi-lambda, and push it forward by the stated measurable map.
Define finite-horizon prediction and update arrays for the SME-44 model, require SPD innovation matrices, and compute the gain by Cholesky triangular solves without forming an inverse.
Stack the independent Gaussian inputs, apply the affine state-observation map, compute its joint covariance, condition on the SPD innovation block, and verify the Joseph identity.

Induct on time. Extend the previous filtering kernel by independent new noises, push it through the affine state-observation map, use the one-step Gaussian conditioner, and verify the full-history RCD identity on history rectangles before pi-lambda extension.
Substitute the one-step scalar matrices and variances, compute S=3, K=2/3, posterior mean 4/3 and covariance 2/3, and invoke the exact-filter theorem for the selected version.
Verify the rank-one prior covariance, compute S=2 and K=(1/2,1/2)^T, then calculate the exact mean and singular posterior covariance.
